title: Waste valorization: harnessing biogas plant residues for fuel production
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2045-2062
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00227C, Paper
Violeta Carolina Wills, Julie Katerine Rodriguez
This study examines the hydrothermal liquefaction (HTL) of digestate fibers from biogas plants into biocrude, followed by downstream processing to produce renewable diesel and marine fuel.
